text:
Maya Patel: quick recap — alpha model (12B) bring-up econ + product guidance
Samir Roy: TL;DR on unit econ?
Maya Patel: measured token cost: baseline-prod-13B int8 ~ $0.20/1k tokens, alpha-12B int4 ~ $0.06/1k tokens (steady state)
Ezra Chen: whoa 70% cost down. What's the quality delta?
Maya Patel: avg QA f1 on GTN slices: down 3.1% absolute on short Q&A, down 7.8% on longform summarization slices
Leah Gomez: product asks: longform is user-visible; 7.8% drop might be noticed. Can we route longform to fallback?
Samir Roy: routing idea: detect prompt length > 1024 tokens OR output expected > 200 tokens -> route to alpha-12B-int8 variant (higher fidelity) else serve int4
Maya Patel: mech: we have two quant profiles: int4-fast (cheap) and int8-fallback (2.4x cost). baseline-prod stays as final fallback for worst cases
eval-bot: eval snapshot uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/alpha-5310001234/snapshot.json — perf: latency p95 230ms (int4), 380ms (int8)
Ezra Chen: suggestion: pilot config: 10% baseline fallback traffic, 20% int8 for longform, 70% int4 — monitor quality regressions and error rates for 48h
Leah Gomez: from GTN POV: recommend product choose tolerance bands per route. propose threshold: <=5% QA drop for search/chat, <=3% for intent-extraction, and require A/B on longform with holdback
Maya Patel: operational asks: we need a canary flag (alpha.econ.routing) + dashboards: token-cost, p95 latency, longform f1 rolling 24h. Also a kill-switch
Samir Roy: I'll add rollout toggles and a canary runbook. Who owns A/B analysis with product?
Leah Gomez: I'll coordinate with GTN analytics. Can we get a quick decision by EOD Friday so sales pilots can start next week?
Maya Patel: yes — final ask to product: accept routing plan above or list firms where longform must be pinned to baseline. :thumbsup:
